subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Though Amal took continuous medication, he was not able to _______________ his injury.
solution:
The correct answer is '**heal**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**heal**" means to become healthy or whole again. (ठीक होना)
 
• In the context of the sentence, it fits best as Amal was unable to recover from his injury despite taking medication.
 
• The other options: "**heel**," "**hail**," and "**hill**" do not fit the context.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Heel (एड़ी)**: refers to the back part of the foot below the ankle.
 
• **Hail (ओले)**: refers to small balls of ice that fall from the sky, or to greet enthusiastically.
 
• **Hill (पहाड़ी)**: refers to a naturally raised area of land.
